question: How much player equipment is genuinely missing from the FFOne asset tree, and can the gap be published?

correctedMeasurement.previousMethod: XDT item mesh strings compared with characters/player/items/catalog.json trueName
whyWrong: One legacy NIF can contain several named parts. `wear/back_cardboardwings.nif` publishes as `back_cardboardwing` AND `back_penguinpal`, so a published trueName is often not any NIF file stem: 150 of 1465 published models are in that state.
The XDT names the NIF file; the catalog names the parts inside it. Comparing the two invents hundreds of gaps.
trueName is not the runtime's resolution key. `data/character_creation/avatar_items.json` is: it carries a per-gender `modelStatus` and the `exactRoute` (`wear/*.nif`) of every resolved model.
correctedMeasurement.correctMethod: read modelStatus per gender slot from the generated avatar_items.json

findings: Player equipment is 6659/6669 = 99.85 percent resolved. The real gap is four weapon models, not 188.

The 159 `missing` slots whose table row names no model are correct behaviour: a boys-only shoe, shirt or trouser has no female model, and the two Invisible Hovercar/Hoverboard vehicles are invisible by design.
pistol_musket (item 758, M.U.S.K.E.T.) has no `wear/pistol_musket.nif` in the clean build or in the Academy donor. It cannot be published.

All four publishable weapons live in CharacterSelection.resourceFile and their XDT primary textures exist: shattergun_wilt, rocket_mojotankcannon and melee_eduardoclub name themselves, melee_razor names mob_knifetoenail in NpcTexture.resourceFile.

replay: cargo run -p ffone-asset-pipeline --bin ffone-asset-pipeline -- accept-equipment-gpu-batch 'work\legacy-sources\equip-additive-20260902\candidates' 'work\legacy-sources\equip-additive-20260902\gpu-evidence-full' '..\FFOneClient\target\release-fast\examples\logical_model_gpu_preview.exe' full 'work\legacy-sources\equip-additive-20260902\gpu-batch-full.json'

installBlocker.cause: install-player-equipment writes the retired pre-organization layout `characters/player/equipment/` and maintains a global asset-manifest.json. The tree has since been migrated by organize-player-item-sets into `characters/player/items/` with a ffone.player-item-set-catalog.v1 catalog, and verify_player_item_sets now REJECTS the existence of characters/player/equipment. The global manifest was removed with the same migration.
installBlocker.sameClassAs: the world-tile blocker in published-asset-census-20260902: an organizer performed a one-way migration and the upstream installer has not caught up
requiredWork: A new incremental installer for the organized layout that, per model, creates characters/player/items/<category>/<name>/{set.json,models/<name>/{item.json,model.glb},textures/<name>.png} and atomically appends to characters/player/items/catalog.json.

Its identity derivation is verified: item id = 'player-item-' + blake3(characters/player/equipment/<category>/<trueName>/<trueName>.glb); a single-member set id is 'player-item-set-' + the same hash. Recomputing that for the installed back_alien reproduces fc2d2f7c765af95c9d3cddbee4e45b8320ebbd7dd23031e57c4bbf634f09d86f exactly.

The set's primary texture must come from the XDT item texture column, not from the NIF material: the batch publication embeds only ToonRamp9 because the material slot references an external link_a.dds. A resolved weapon such as theown_discobomb carries textures/thrown_spideregg.png, which is its XDT texture name.
After installing, regenerate data/character_creation/avatar_items.json so the four modelStatus entries flip from missing to verified.
